{{Quote|She'll never go out with you. She's gonna go out with me.|This Rodian to a Quarren|<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>}}
This '''unidentified [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]''' was a patron of [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], when [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] entered the tavern. He was seen watching a [[Unidentified Twi'lek (Moshi Bar)/Legends|Twi'lek dancer]] with a [[Unidentified Quarren (Moshi Bar)/Legends|male Quarren]] while they argued about who she would go out with. When [[Fong Do/Legends|Fong Do]] and a [[Unidentified Weequay pirate (Moshi Bar)/Legends|Weequay pirate]] caught Ahsoka eavesdropping, this Rodian pulled out a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], along with everyone else, but hesitated firing after Plo ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He, like the other patrons, bought Ahsoka's gold [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] distraction and let the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] get away.
